name: Ricardo Sepúlveda
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport began in the dusty Atacama Desert, where he tinkered with engines from a young age, fueled by a relentless curiosity for how things worked. He earned a degree in mechanical engineering and spent years honing his skills in various Chilean rally teams before making the leap to international rallycross. Ricardo's approach is meticulous, data-driven, and relentlessly focused on extracting every last bit of performance from the car. He is known for his exceptional ability to diagnose complex mechanical issues under pressure, often finding unconventional solutions that others overlook.

He joined Hansen World RX Team a few seasons ago, bringing with him a wealth of experience and a no-nonsense attitude that both challenges and inspires his colleagues. While not always the easiest person to work with, Ricardo's dedication to winning is undeniable, and his insightful feedback is invaluable to the team's success. His experience allows him to anticipate issues and adjust the car before problems emerge, giving the driver confidence to push harder.

physical.description: Ricardo is a stocky man with strong hands, a testament to years of working with machinery.

quirks: Meticulously cleans his workspace, even at the track
Communicates primarily through technical jargon and hand gestures
